providerDefault: none, video bytes are returned inline
summary: Writes generated videos to a Cloud Storage location instead of returning base64 bytes.
combines: Supported on: Vertex only. Wire name `storageUri` in the Vertex `parameters` object; `outputGcsUri` is the SDK name. The Gemini Developer API returns a file handle you download through `files.download`.
Requires a Google Cloud project and bucket, so it is unusable with an API-key-only Gemini client.
